**Observation Log:**

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed accommodations with bike storage options in Lake Tahoe, Jackson Hole, Mount Rushmore, Minneapolis, and Pittsburgh.
- [PREFERENCE] User is excited about the scenic routes and bike-friendly stops.
- [CHANGE] User mentioned they just got a new hybrid bike recently.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on the new hybrid bike and provided tips for ensuring the safety and security of all four bikes during the trip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended booking accommodations with bike storage in advance and confirmed with each hotel that they can accommodate all four bikes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested investing in high-quality bike covers or bags, bringing multiple locks, performing regular maintenance checks, and considering a bike rack or trailer for transport.
- [EVENT] User expressed interest in joining a guided tour in Jackson Hole to explore challenging mountain bike trails.
